Values: digitized.csv (67 rows; tools/litdb/vuquoc1999_nfd_reproduce.py --digitize — PDF pages 11 · 13 · 15 · 23 are sheared in the scan (vertical frame lines dx/dy −0.009 to −0.013, horizontal lines level), so x is read near the axis it is calibrated on; pages 14 · 24 · 30 are not) and the re-implementation of eqs (3.7)–(3.22) + Algorithms 3.2/3.3 + the §4 collision (same tool, --selftest = 15/15 printed values reproduced). Printed inconsistencies seen in the crops (not fixed): C_a unit "N m⁻¹" (must be m N⁻¹ by eq. 2.5); (3.17) 2nd term has an extra P factor; (4.7) second form is loading over unloading with shifted trapezoid indices; Fig. 12 y-tick label "2 × 10⁻⁴" sits on the first tick (the other two labels give 1 × 10⁻⁴ per tick) and its model lines read ~8 % above eq. (2.5) with the printed C_a, while Fig. 17 agrees with the printed C_a; Algorithm 3.3 loops on F(P) > Tol whereas p.4038 states the relative-increment test (4.8).
key_note: keys: f<N> = Figure N (caption included) · f<N><a|b> = panel (panel_of) · ealg3_2 / ealg3_3 = Algorithm 3.2 / 3.3 · e<sec>_<NN> = Equation (sec.N) · x<PDF page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind "text"); page = PDF page (printed page = page + 4011, also stored as printed_page); bbox = ink box in PDF points; images are 1-bit 600 dpi crops of the native JBIG2 raster except Fig. 18 and Eq. (4.1) (page 25 rendered at 600 dpi grey)
